ref_text: The night was cold and very quiet. Most of the street was asleep, and the lamps hummed over the empty road. Somewhere far away, a train rolled past, and then the silence came back.

lines.text: You get one look at this man before he runs.
And now a hundred men are wearing his cap.
Whoever you pick goes to jail.
Did you even look behind them?
He's been standing right there the whole time.
When every hand went up for a cap, he took his off.
With a stranger, your brain goes by the hair and the cap.
And the man you picked goes to jail, for a cap he caught a minute ago.
And the man you chose goes to jail, for a cap he caught a minute ago.
So did you learn his face, or his cap?
